about: QA1 A5 and A2 house style exceptions (owner approved QA1, 9 Nov 2026). allow: official names, titles, citations and addresses that keep their hyphen or wording; they are removed from the text before the rules run. skip_files: paths or folders not scanned for A5 because readers never see them (internal tools, design mock-ups). time_words_allow: text in which a time relative word is part of an official name or a quotation (A2). time_words_skip_routes: page types that show the official record word for word (Hansard, petitions, motions, written questions, the register), whose wording is not ours (A2).
